couplings.risk_description: Agent Canvas ships bundled JS assets with Vite-generated content hashes (e.g. active-backend-context-*.js, settings-*.js). Updating agent-canvas overwrites build/ and invalidates previous string anchors (value:`uk`}, language:`en`). Localization patcher must be validated against every new canvas version.
couplings.failure_mode: UI falls back to English or fails to render language switcher
couplings.mitigation: Strict parity audit script (audit-localization.py) + automatic rollback if missing keys > 0 or patch fails

couplings.risk_description: Updating agent-canvas overwrites build/index.html, erasing the injected <link> and <script> tags for voice-bridge.css and voice-bridge.js.
couplings.failure_mode: Voice recording button disappears from Agent Canvas UI
couplings.mitigation: Idempotent voice patch script run immediately after canvas update

couplings.risk_description: agent-canvas config/defaults.json defines exact versions for agentServer (1.44.0) and automation (1.9.0) launched via uvx. Updating agent-canvas can automatically pull newer PyPI versions of agent-server and automation without separate notice.
couplings.failure_mode: Newer backend might have broken tools or breaking schema changes with agent_settings

couplings.risk_description: Qwen 3.8 relies on ik_llama's custom speculative decoding (--spec-type mtp:n_max=3,p_min=0.0) and multimodal projector (--mmproj). If ik_llama modifies CLI syntax or breaks multimodal projector loading, Qwen multimodal inference fails.
couplings.failure_mode: Inference crash, silent degradation to non-speculative, or vision load failure
couplings.mitigation: Stage 7B hardened staging gate (QWEN_MAIN_LOAD, QWEN_MMPROJ_LOAD, QWEN_MTP_AVAILABLE, SHORT_TEXT_COMPLETION)

couplings.risk_description: Ornith relies on custom MTP speculative decoding (--spec-type mtp:n_max=1,p_min=0.75).
couplings.failure_mode: Ornith fails to boot under llama-swap
couplings.mitigation: Stage 7B Ornith compatibility gate in update-ik-llama.ps1

couplings.risk_description: Qwen3-Next relies on official llama.cpp draft-mtp flags (-md <mtp-model> --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 1 --reasoning-format deepseek). If mainline llama.cpp renames draft-mtp arguments, Next will fail to start.
couplings.failure_mode: llama-swap fails to launch Next, returning HTTP 502/500
couplings.mitigation: Command flag validation before promoting candidate build

couplings.risk_description: llama-swap parses K:\Project\llama-swap\config.yaml. If upstream v255 changes YAML structure, healthCheckTimeout format, or env var interpolation syntax (${PORT}), router fails to boot.
couplings.failure_mode: All model routing collapses; OpenHands cannot reach any LLM
couplings.mitigation: Staging config dry-run with candidate binary before swapping production exe

couplings.risk_description: transcribe_cpp Python module binds via ctypes to transcribe.dll, which expects specific RNN-T GGML tensor structures. Updating transcribe.cpp without updating the model or vice-versa causes segfaults.
couplings.mitigation: Keep transcribe.dll pinned unless model is updated in lockstep
